steps.instruction: Open the Add menu at the top of the 3D view.
steps.spoken: Let's start with the donut shape. Open the Add menu.
steps.why: Every new object in Blender starts from the Add menu.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The Add menu is in the bar above the 3D view, next to Select.

steps.why: Meshes are solid shapes made of faces, like a cube or a ring.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Mesh is the first item in the Add menu.

steps.spoken: Pick Torus. That ring is our donut.
steps.why: A torus is a ring shape, which is what a donut is.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Torus is in the list that opened next to Mesh.

steps.spoken: The donut looks blocky. Open the Object menu to smooth it.
steps.why: Shading controls how light slides over the surface, so a round shape looks round.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The Object menu is in the bar above the 3D view, right after Add.

steps.spoken: Click Shade Smooth. The harsh edges blend away.
steps.why: Think of it like sanding a wooden shape until it feels smooth.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Shade Smooth is in the middle of the Object menu, above Shade Flat.

steps.instruction: In the Properties panel on the right, click the blue wrench icon (the Modifiers tab).
steps.spoken: Now find the blue wrench icon in the panel on the right. That is the Modifiers tab.
steps.why: Modifiers change a shape without destroying it, so you can undo them any time.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The wrench is in the column of small icons on the right edge, below the orange square.

steps.spoken: Click Add Modifier to see the list of effects.
steps.why: This is the shop window for all of Blender's shape effects.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Add Modifier is the wide button at the top of the Modifiers tab.

steps.why: Generate modifiers build new geometry from your shape.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Generate is the second group in the list.

steps.spoken: Pick Subdivision Surface. It rounds the donut off nicely.
steps.why: It adds extra detail so blocky shapes become soft, like pressing clay into a ball.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Subdivision Surface is in the list that opened next to Generate.
